description.value: A three-generation family-run lodge and campground at Historic Mile 375 of the Alaska Highway, Tetsa River Lodge has been welcoming travellers since 1942 and is widely celebrated as the 'Cinnamon Bun Centre of the Galactic Cluster.' Five self-catering rustic cabins, 30 RV sites with power and water, and open tent camping occupy a quiet wilderness setting alongside the Tetsa River. An on-site gift shop and café offers freshly baked cinnamon buns, artisan meats, homemade bread, and daily soup — all made on premises.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is available and detailed. The RV & Campsites page explicitly confirms Wi-Fi is included for both RV sites and tent campers. The phone number shown throughout the website (1-780-882-3248, Alberta area code 780) differs from the OSM tag (+1-250-774-1005, BC area code 250) on every page — the website value is used as more current. No bicycle-specific amenities (secure storage, tools, e-bike charging, bike wash) are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: Phone number mismatch: OSM lists +1-250-774-1005 (BC area code 250), but the website consistently shows 1-780-882-3248 (Alberta area code 780) across all pages. Website value used as it appears more current.

GPS coordinate discrepancy: OSM places the node at 58.6526°N, but the website Location page gives GPS as 59°39'9"N (≈59.653°N) — approximately 1 degree (~110 km) difference in latitude. May be a website typo; OSM coordinate may be more reliable.
Seasonal operation only (to October 1); cyclists travelling outside the operating season will find the property closed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established, family-run Alaska Highway landmark with cabins, RV sites, and tent camping — a natural and notable resupply and rest stop for touring cyclists on this remote corridor.
enrichment_extras.notes: The café explicitly does not offer full meals. Cabins 1 and 2 lack showers (shared washroom/shower building nearby); Cabins 3 and 4 have no washroom facilities at all; Cabin 5 has a full bathroom with shower. Gas and diesel are available on site.

Wi-Fi.detail: RV & Campsites page lists 'wifi' among included site amenities; tenting fee also stated to include 'showers & Wifi'
